title: DragonWoven
description: this mod adds a new resource that drop's from the ender dragon and can be applied to chainmail to get armor as good as diamonds, but with some special ability's
body:
<details>
<summary>what this changes about base minecraft</summary>

phantom membranes are renamed and retextured to phantom tendens

enderpearls are now called "ball o' enderman"

</details>



<details>
<summary>Spoiler for the entire mod</summary>

this mod basicaly overhauls chainmail so i will start by explaining the early game of the mod

<details>
<summary>Early game</summary>

from villagers you can obtain chainweave

using chainweave you can craft chainmail armor, and the new chainwoven elytra
this is an elytra that cannot be enchanted and only flys for 2 minuets so if you need to get somewere fast you can, with some risk involved

</details>

that is the early game of the mod, now moving to the end fight

<details>
<summary>Post end-fight</summary>

the enderdragon now drops 3-5 dragonscales
these can be used with the new tendenwrapped sticks to create dragonscale tools

or you can use dragonscales with chainweave to create the main recorce of the mod: Dragonweave

</details>

now to explain dragonweave:


<details>
<summary>Dragonweave</summary>

to use dragonweave you need a new item called shulker inscription dropped from shulkers
if you have the item you can use it in the smithing table with chainmail armor to create dragonwoven armor, an alternative to netherite that is not as strong but more usefull

using a regular elytra, dragonweave, and a few other items,
you can create the dragonwoven elytra, (one of my favorate items)

and if you combine the dragonwoven chestplate with the dragonwoven elytra in a smithing table you can create the truedragon chestpeice,

and this has nothing to do with dragonweave but if you combine some shulker shells with some armor stands then you can create the shulker pocket,

the shulker pocket is an item that contains armor,
shift rightclick the item outside of the inventory to store the armor your wearing in the pocket, from that point on right click the item at any time to swap the armor your wearing with the armor in the pocket, be carefull not to use the shift-rightclick again or otherwise you might just loose a peice of armor to the abyss

</details>

now to explain the special abelitys of the armor and tools:


<details>
<summary>special abelitys</summary>

EVERY single dragonwoven armor and dragonscale tool are unbreakable

starting with the armor:

the helmet allows you to look at endermen without angering them 
the chestplate does nothing 
the leggings increce your speed 
the boots give you immunity to levetation

now special armor peices:

dragonwoven elytra removes fall damage
truedragon chestpeice also removes all fall damage

now tools:

dragonscale sword deals dragonfire damage that goes through armor 
dragonscale axe gives a couple seconds of levetation to the target when used on a foe 
dragonscale pickaxe can be used on a dragonhead in the crafting table to get extra dragonscales 
dragonscale hoe is useless 
dragonscale shovel has no special abelitys

</details>


<details>
<summary>other things in the mod</summary>

shulker tofu, dropped from shulkers, raw version gives a few seconds, cooked version is a very good foodsorce

honeycomb calcite, around the end you can find deposits of honeycomb calcite, it can be made into many building blocks but it is a very tough block so it can only be cut by a stonecutter

in end city chests you can now find starlace saplings and these grow into a tree that does not spawn naturaly but has a beautiful indigo color, and from the leaves you can get the new nyxfruit,

nyxfruit when eaten gives 30 seconds of the new effect: lunargravity
this effect removes gravity, so you can walk across the void or other things, be carefull not to jump without somthing to catch your fall becouse you go up like 40 blocks with this effect

nyxfruit is used for the potion of lunargravity

this mod also adds a block called fertilendstone, it can have flowers and saplings grow on it


</details>




</details>
